spans.s:
अक्त 1. अक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (part. of rt. अञ्च् or अञ्ज्
in the sense ‘to go’), gone.

अक्त 2. अक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (part. of rt. अञ्ज्),
smeared over; diffused; bedaubed, tinged, characterized.
It is often the last part of a compound word; as, रक्ताक्त,
tinged with red or blood; (अम्), n. oil, ointment.

अक्तु, उस्, f. (m. ?), Ved. ointment; tinge, ray, light,
star (?); dark tinge, darkness, night.
अक्तोस्, अक्तुभिस्, ind., Ved. at night.
अक्त्वा (ind. part. of rt. अञ्ज्), having besmeared.
